mechanism.claim: When BTC crosses the midpoint of its completed seven-day auction range at an actual funding settlement while both realized variation and absolute funding are causally elevated, leveraged participation confirms a value-regime migration that persists for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on a strict upward prior-range-midpoint crossing; short on a strict downward crossing
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCFRR uses a transition through the fixed midpoint of a trailing external high-low range, not HVCFBR's range escape, HVCFMR's completed-move reversal, a funding-sign rule, first difference, fitted channel, or prior control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed intervening eight-hour BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper 40 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: actual funding-settlement clocks conditioned on seven-day range-midpoint transitions and causal funding rank are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.previous_settlement: immediately prior actual settlement P with S-P exactly 8 elapsed hours
features.funding_level: finite nonzero funding_rate[S], used only through absolute magnitude
features.absolute_level_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(funding_rate[S]) over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.completed_cycle: exact coherent BTCUSDT one-minute OHLC aggregation over [P,S)
features.prior_range: maximum high and minimum low of the 21 uninterrupted completed eight-hour cycles ending at P; the current [P,S) cycle is excluded
features.range_midpoint: arithmetic midpoint of the prior range high and low
features.regime_cross: last close at P at or below midpoint and last close before S strictly above maps long; last close at P at or above midpoint and current close strictly below maps short; exactly one direction required
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns over exactly 480 coherent BTCUSDT bars [P,S))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.eligible: the exact eight-hour settlement gap, 22 uninterrupted coherent cycles including current, finite nonzero funding, one strict range-midpoint crossing, and both ranks pass at S; no funding-sign relation, divergence, first difference, OI, premium, alt, or post-settlement condition

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: signal settlement precedes entry; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.bars: Postgres bars_binance BTCUSDT exact coherent 1m OHLC
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no settlement gap, prior-range length, midpoint-cross definition, history, level-rank, side, variation, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
